name: Huabao International Holdings Limited
summary: Huabao International Holdings Limited, an investment holding company, engages in the research and development, production, distribution, and sale of flavors, fragrances, food ingredients, tobacco and aroma raw materials, and condiments primarily in the People's Republic of China. It offers paper-making products, reconstituted tobacco leaves, and new material products for the tobacco industry. The company is also involved in the production and sale of natural extracts; tobacco flavours and fragrances; cigarette paper and auxiliary products; perfumes; and food flavors and fragrances, as well as offers administrative and management and consultancy services.
